{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
filtered_data = data[
    (data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) &
    (data['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Define eligible customers: loyal and returning (high-value)
eligible_data = filtered_data[filtered_data['customer_segment'].isin(['loyal', 'returning'])]

# Compute conversion rate by channel and segment
conversion_by_segment = eligible_data.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean()

# Compute total counts per channel
channel_totals = eligible_data.groupby('channel').size()

# Compute weighted conversion rate per channel correctly
# For email:
email_loyal_count = eligible_data[(eligible_data['channel'] == 'email') & (eligible_data['customer_segment'] == 'loyal')].shape[0]
email_returning_count = eligible_data[(eligible_data['channel'] == 'email') & (eligible_data['customer_segment'] == 'returning')].shape[0]
email_loyal_conv = conversion_by_segment['email', 'loyal']
email_returning_conv = conversion_by_segment['email', 'returning']
weighted_email = (email_loyal_conv * email_loyal_count + email_returning_conv * email_returning_count) / (email_loyal_count + email_returning_count)

# For paid_search:
paid_search_loyal_count = eligible_data[(eligible_data['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (eligible_data['customer_segment'] == 'loyal')].shape[0]
paid_search_returning_count = eligible_data[(eligible_data['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (eligible_data['customer_segment'] == 'returning')].shape[0]
paid_search_loyal_conv = conversion_by_segment['paid_search', 'loyal']
paid_search_returning_conv = conversion_by_segment['paid_search', 'returning']
weighted_paid_search = (paid_search_loyal_conv * paid_search_loyal_count + paid_search_returning_conv * paid_search_returning_count) / (paid_search_loyal_count + paid_search_returning_count)

# Compute difference
diff = weighted_email - weighted_paid_search

# Output
print(f"Weighted conversion rate (email): {weighted_email:.4f}")
print(f"Weighted conversion rate (paid_search): {weighted_paid_search:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {diff:.6f} ({diff*100:.4f} percentage points)")"}
